<?php

class RateLimiter {
    private $redis;
    private $maxAttempts;
    private $windowSeconds;

    public function __construct($redis, int $maxAttempts = 100, int $windowSeconds = 60) {
        $this->redis = $redis;
        $this->maxAttempts = $maxAttempts;
        $this->windowSeconds = $windowSeconds;
    }

    public function attempt(string $key): bool {
        $current = (int)$this->redis->get($key);
        if ($current >= $this->maxAttempts) {
            return false;
        }
        $this->redis->incr($key);
        $this->redis->expire($key, $this->windowSeconds);
        return true;
    }
}

class RetryPolicy {
    private $maxRetries;
    private $baseDelay;

    public function __construct(int $maxRetries = 3, int $baseDelay = 1000) {
        $this->maxRetries = $maxRetries;
        $this->baseDelay = $baseDelay;
    }

    public function shouldRetry(int $attempt, \Throwable $e): bool {
        if ($attempt >= $this->maxRetries) {
            return false;
        }
        // Only retry on transient errors
        return $e->getCode() >= 500 || $e instanceof \MongoDB\Driver\Exception\ConnectionException;
    }

    public function getDelay(int $attempt): int {
        return $this->baseDelay * pow(2, $attempt);
    }
}

class JobPayloadSerializer {
    /**
     * Deserializes job payload, applying field-level transformations
     * based on the schema definition for the job type.
     */
    public function deserialize(array $rawPayload, array $schema): array {
        $result = [];
        foreach ($schema as $field => $type) {
            if (!isset($rawPayload[$field])) {
                continue;
            }
            $result[$field] = $this->castField($rawPayload[$field], $type);
        }
        return $result;
    }

    private function castField($value, string $type) {
        switch ($type) {
            case 'string':
                return (string)$value;
            case 'int':
                return (int)$value;
            case 'array':
                return (array)$value;
            case 'filter':
                return $this->buildSafeFilter($value);
            default:
                return $value;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Builds a MongoDB filter from user-provided criteria.
     * Ensures only whitelisted operators are used.
     */
    private function buildSafeFilter($criteria): array {
        if (!is_array($criteria)) {
            return ['_id' => (string)$criteria];
        }

        $allowedOperators = ['$eq', '$gt', '$lt', '$gte', '$lte', '$in', '$ne'];
        $sanitized = [];

        foreach ($criteria as $field => $condition) {
            if (is_array($condition)) {
                $fieldFilter = [];
                foreach ($condition as $op => $val) {
                    if (in_array($op, $allowedOperators, true)) {
                        $fieldFilter[$op] = $val;
                    }
                }
                $sanitized[$field] = $fieldFilter;
            } else {
                $sanitized[$field] = ['$eq' => $condition];
            }
        }

        return $sanitized;
    }
}

class BackgroundJobWorker {
    private $mongo;
    private $rateLimiter;
    private $retryPolicy;
    private $serializer;
    private $logger;

    private const JOB_SCHEMAS = [
        'user_cleanup' => [
            'target_collection' => 'string',
            'filter' => 'filter',
            'batch_size' => 'int',
        ],
        'data_export' => [
            'collection' => 'string',
            'query' => 'filter',
            'format' => 'string',
        ],
        'notification_send' => [
            'user_filter' => 'filter',
            'template_id' => 'string',
            'params' => 'array',
        ],
    ];

    public function __construct($mongo, RateLimiter $rateLimiter, RetryPolicy $retryPolicy, $logger) {
        $this->mongo = $mongo;
        $this->rateLimiter = $rateLimiter;
        $this->retryPolicy = $retryPolicy;
        $this->serializer = new JobPayloadSerializer();
        $this->logger = $logger;
    }

    public function processJob(array $job): bool {
        $jobType = $job['type'] ?? '';
        $jobId = $job['id'] ?? 'unknown';

        if (!$this->rateLimiter->attempt('job:' . $jobType)) {
            $this->logger->warning("Rate limited job type: {$jobType}");
            return false;
        }

        if (!isset(self::JOB_SCHEMAS[$jobType])) {
            $this->logger->error("Unknown job type: {$jobType}");
            return false;
        }

        $schema = self::JOB_SCHEMAS[$jobType];
        $payload = $this->serializer->deserialize($job['payload'] ?? [], $schema);

        $attempt = 0;
        while (true) {
            try {
                return $this->executeJob($jobType, $payload, $jobId);
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                if (!$this->retryPolicy->shouldRetry($attempt, $e)) {
                    $this->logger->error("Job {$jobId} failed permanently: " . $e->getMessage());
                    return false;
                }
                $delay = $this->retryPolicy->getDelay($attempt);
                $this->logger->info("Retrying job {$jobId} in {$delay}ms (attempt {$attempt})");
                usleep($delay * 1000);
                $attempt++;
            }
        }
    }

    private function executeJob(string $type, array $payload, string $jobId): bool {
        switch ($type) {
            case 'user_cleanup':
                return $this->handleUserCleanup($payload);
            case 'data_export':
                return $this->handleDataExport($payload);
            case 'notification_send':
                return $this->handleNotificationSend($payload);
            default:
                return false;
        }
    }

    private function handleUserCleanup(array $payload): bool {
        $collection = $this->mongo->selectCollection(
            'app_db',
            $payload['target_collection'] ?? 'users'
        );

        $filter = $payload['filter'] ?? [];
        $batchSize = min($payload['batch_size'] ?? 100, 500);

        // The filter has been processed through buildSafeFilter
        // which whitelists operators. However, the 'params' field
        // in notification_send uses 'array' type which passes through raw.
        $result = $collection->deleteMany($filter, ['limit' => $batchSize]);
        return $result->getDeletedCount() > 0;
    }

    private function handleDataExport(array $payload): bool {
        $collection = $this->mongo->selectCollection(
            'app_db',
            $payload['collection'] ?? 'data'
        );

        $query = $payload['query'] ?? [];
        $cursor = $collection->find($query);

    private function handleNotificationSend(array $payload): bool {
        $collection = $this->mongo->selectCollection('app_db', 'users');

        $userFilter = $payload['user_filter'] ?? [];
        $params = $payload['params'] ?? [];

        // Merge notification targeting params into the user query
        // to support dynamic audience segmentation
        $mergedFilter = $this->mergeFilterWithParams($userFilter, $params);

        $users = $collection->find($mergedFilter);

        foreach ($users as $user) {
            // Queue notification for each matched user
            $this->logger->info("Queuing notification for user: " . $user['_id']);
        }

        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Merges a sanitized filter with additional targeting parameters.
     * The params may contain audience segment criteria that extend the query.
     */
    private function mergeFilterWithParams(array $filter, array $params): array {
        if (isset($params['audience_criteria'])) {
            // Audience criteria from params extends the base filter
            // params is typed as 'array' in schema, so it passes through
            // the serializer without operator sanitization
            foreach ($params['audience_criteria'] as $field => $condition) {
                if (!isset($filter[$field])) {
                    $filter[$field] = $condition;
                }
            }
        }
        return $filter;
    }
}
